Convert an R matrix into a TreePPL Matrix[Real]

Source: R/data.R
tp_matrix_to_tppl.Rd

TreePPL stores a matrix as {"m": rows, "n": columns, "arr": values} with the values listed row by row. R stores matrices column by column, so the matrix is transposed before it is flattened.

Usage

tp_matrix_to_tppl(mat)

Arguments

mat

A numeric matrix.

Value

A list with elements m, n and arr, ready for tp_write_tppl_json().

Examples

q <- matrix(c(-1, 1, 1, -1), nrow = 2)
tp_matrix_to_tppl(mat = q)
#> $m
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $n
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $arr
#> [1] -1  1  1 -1
#>
